title: Catheter Fee Schedule and Monthly Catheter Quantities, Urological Supply Program
content:
Catheter fee-schedule amounts and monthly catheter quantities for the six programs of the Urological Supply Program.

## Definitions

- **Catheters per month** — catheters allowed per month of supply (units).
- **Fee per catheter** — the fee-schedule amount per catheter before the coverage class's allowed percentage (USD).
- **Extra catheters with documentation** — additional catheters per month allowed when obstruction, infection or leakage is documented (units); 0 when none.
- **Per-catheterization cap** — whether the monthly limit is further capped at one catheter per ordered catheterization per day.
- **Change interval** — days between routine changes of an indwelling catheter that the monthly limit is built on (days); 0 for other programs.

## Schedule

| Program | Catheters per month | Fee per catheter (USD) | Extra catheters with documentation | Per-catheterization cap | Change interval (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | 200 | 1.98 | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | 200 | 7.42 | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | 200 | 7.91 | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | 1 | 12.48 | 2 | no | 30 |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | 1 | 19.53 | 2 | no | 30 |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | 35 | 2.46 | 0 | no | 0 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The three intermittent programs (A4351, A4352, A4353) each allow 200 catheters a month and carry the per-catheterization cap; they differ in the fee per catheter: 1.98, 7.42 and 7.91 USD.
- The two indwelling programs allow 1 catheter a month, built on a routine change every 30 days, with up to 2 extra catheters a month when obstruction, infection or leakage is documented. Their fees per catheter are 12.48 USD (A4338) and 19.53 USD (A4344).
- The Male External Catheter Program allows 35 catheters a month at 2.46 USD each, with no extra allowance and no per-catheterization cap.
- The fee per catheter is the amount before the coverage class's allowed percentage; it is not itself the allowed amount of a line.

## Hypothetical illustration of the per-catheterization cap

A hypothetical order on the Straight Intermittent Catheter Program specifies 4 catheterizations a day. Under the per-catheterization cap, no more than 4 catheters are furnished for each day of supply, and the monthly figure of 200 catheters applies as well; neither limit is exceeded. A hypothetical order on the Male External Catheter Program is held only to its monthly figure of 35, because that program carries no per-catheterization cap. The order figures here are illustrative only.
